name: lightning_order
question: Lightning strikes in a hidden random order (random_removal): an explosive psion struck before or after the Vek next to a mech decides whether the Vek explodes (stage 7 vector 29).
mission: Mission_Lightning (sand island, 'Lightning Storm'), a player turn with at least two lightning marks
repeat: Repeat on several turns or missions: each run shows one of the two orders.
observe: env_strike_log (or the phase log's env_step entries) gives the order the strikes hit.
Psion struck first: the Scorpion dies without exploding and mech 0 keeps its HP.
Scorpion struck first: it explodes (psion alive) and mech 0 loses 1 HP.
The engine prints one outcome per order (--branches); the matching one must be the order the game logged.
